# STT-Whisper-Pashto

Fine-tuned Whisper model for Pashto Speech Recognition.

## Base Model

* Whisper Small

## Training Method

* LoRA Fine-Tuning

## Dataset

Pashto ASR Dataset
* Kaggle: https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/itssabtain/pashto-asr-dataset (Recommended)
* Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Sabtain-Dev/Pashto-ASR-Dataset
* Github Repository: https://github.com/Sabtain-Dev/STT-Whisper-Pashto

## Best Result

WER: 43.83%
